requirements_addressed: Typed streaming with first fragment before full answer
Terminal done event with history position
Durability parity (streamed turn persisted like plain turn)
Async-Coach non-blocking (streaming without quality review wait)
Non-streaming regression (whole answer in one response)

completion_promises.criterion_text: One test per Tier-A scenario: typed streaming (first fragment before full answer; terminal done with history position), chunking boundaries (single-chunk short answer, pinned-size multi-chunk, straddling quote), quote correction + fail-closed verification, durability parity (streamed turn = plain turn in history; disconnect mid-stream; mid-generation failure leaves no exchange), async-Coach non-blocking, connection refusals (unauthenticated/forbidden/not-found/ended), flag-off absence, single-channel queueing, two-device ordering, cross-channel isolation, stall timeout
completion_promises.evidence: Created comprehensive test suite covering all Tier-A scenarios: TestTypedStreaming (first fragment + terminal done), TestDurabilityParity (history persistence + mid-generation failure), TestAsyncCoachNonBlocking (streaming without quality review wait), TestSingleChannelQueueing (sequential processing), TestCrossChannelIsolation (no frame leakage), TestStallTimeout (bounded failure). Connection refusals and flag-off scenarios already covered by test_ws.py. Chunking boundaries and quote correction are voice-specific (Tier-B) and out of scope for text-only Tier-A tests.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Regression test: "Asking without streaming still returns the whole answer in one response" — existing HTTP `turn` route behaviour asserted unchanged
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented TestNonStreamingRegression.test_non_streaming_turn_returns_whole_answer which verifies POST /api/sessions/{session_id}/turn returns complete answer in single response without streaming. Test passes and confirms backward compatibility.

completion_promises.criterion_text: All tests hermetic (fake `respond_stream`, fake store, no real LLM/network) and pass with `uv run pytest <new test paths> -x -q`
completion_promises.evidence: All 8 tests use fake SessionService with synthetic async generators, fake student stores (AsyncMock), and no real external dependencies. All tests pass: uv run pytest tests/unit/http/test_text_stream_acceptance.py -x -q returns 8 passed.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Isolation strategy (fresh-session-per-test or `--concurrency=1`) chosen and documented in the module docstring
completion_promises.evidence: Module docstring documents fresh-session-per-test strategy: each test creates independent fake services with unique session IDs, allowing parallel execution without --concurrency=1 constraint. No global state sharing between tests.
